title: Travis Hegel Marathon du Trans Penang 2026 Review: A French-Named Island 42K
seo_title: Travis Hegel Marathon Penang 2026 Review | Malaysia Race
meta_description: Travis Hegel Marathon du Trans Penang 2026: August 30 at Gertak Sanggul, Penang. A uniquely-named full marathon on Penang Island.
dek: Set for 30 August 2026 at Gertak Sanggul on Penang Island, this uniquely French-named marathon offers a full 42K on Penang's southwest coast.
verdict: The Travis Hegel Marathon du Trans Penang has perhaps the most distinctive name in Malaysian road racing — a French-titled marathon on Penang Island's southwest coast at Gertak Sanggul, a fishing village turned residential area. A single-distance full marathon (41.8km) keeps the format focused. August in Penang is the southwest monsoon — warm and humid. For runners wanting a Penang full marathon with unique branding and a less-touristed corner of the island, this is a distinctive pick.
